description: This PHP class 'OX_Extension_Common' provides a base for extension management in the Revive Adserver, including methods for caching plugin hooks, preferences, diagnostics, and executing tasks related to plugin lifecycle events.

classes.name: OX_Extension_Common
classes.description: Ancestor class for extension manager classes, providing methods for plugin hook caching, preferences, diagnostics, and task execution.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginInstall
methods.description: Runs cache updates after plugin installation.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginUninstall
methods.description: Runs cache updates after plugin uninstallation.

methods.name: runTasksBeforePluginUninstall
methods.description: Placeholder for tasks before plugin uninstallation.

methods.name: runTasksBeforePluginInstall
methods.description: Placeholder for tasks before plugin installation.

methods.name: runTasksBeforePluginEnable
methods.description: Placeholder for tasks before enabling a plugin.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginEnable
methods.description: Runs cache updates after plugin enabling.

methods.name: runTasksBeforePluginDisable
methods.description: Placeholder for tasks before disabling a plugin.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginDisable
methods.description: Runs cache updates after plugin disabling.

methods.name: cacheComponentHooks
methods.description: Caches hooks for enabled plugins, indexed by hook name.

methods.name: getPluginsDiagnostics
methods.description: Retrieves diagnostics information for plugins and plugin groups.

methods.name: runTasksOnDemand
methods.description: Executes a specified task method if it exists.
